name: JPEGDEC
description: bitbank2 JPEGDEC, vendored from x4-os .pio/libdeps (pin 8628297) with CrossPoint's progressive-MCU-skip patches (x4-os scripts/jpegdec_patches) already applied. Trimmed to the decoder core: no examples, no JPEGDisplay wrapper, no S3 SIMD .S files (ESP32-C3 is RISC-V; the S3 path is gated on dsps_fft2r and never compiles here).
